application_credentials.description: Create Google OAuth credentials at {console_url}. Use a Web application OAuth client and add the Home Assistant OAuth redirect URI shown by Home Assistant.

init.title: YouTube Playlists options
init.description: Choose which playlists to import and how clicking a video should play it.

data.playlist_pattern: Pattern (e.g. HA* for a prefix, *Podcast* to match anywhere)
data.play_script: Script to run instead (overrides default script name)
data.notify_script: Script to run when new videos are found

error.pattern_required: Enter a pattern, or switch back to "All playlists".
error.media_player_required: Choose a media player, or switch back to "Run a script".

options.media_player: Play directly on a media player (Android TV / Fire TV)
